Placings of our club members were as under:—Maclean, 1; Adams, P., 2; Wolton, 3; Simpson, 5; Greene, 6; Courtney, 7; Grieves, 8; Butt, 9; Udall, 11.

Peter Courtney was third and Don Maclean, who was the scratch man, seemed to be having a training run only. In the 2 miles walk we saw our old friend Colin Sutton getting among the prizes once again and his trip abroad has evidently not impaired his speed.
He was followed home by Eddie Short and "Ginger" Newell with Hudson and Peter Courtney also running well. Courtney won the handicap held in conjunction, with Hudson and A.
Peter Courtney ran quite well in his first senior race, for although this is known as a Junior event, the word junior applies to ability and not to age.

In the Junior event our first man home was Don Maclean in 6th place and Peter Courtney also ran well to finish 14th.
